current_repo_evidence.claim: Primary 10bps artifact is conservative, locked-OOS report/gate-only, and scores train+validation only.
Assertion surface requires exact 10bps primary cost and locked-OOS non-use flags.
Current cost-validation rows cover report costs 5/10bps and stream costs 0/5/10bps; no explicit 15/20bps grid yet.
Cost-aware framework records fill costs, realized slippage, turnover, participation quantiles, capacity decay, and post-cost MDD metrics.
Backtest cost model supports spread/impact/fees, participation, cap-notional fills, unfilled carry/drop, and no-close-fill execution.
Liquidity proxy computes rolling ADV, ADTV, and sigma for participation/impact capacity checks.
Performance metrics include max drawdown, total return, volatility, Sharpe, and CAGR; tail/CVaR fields are not present here.
Paper fill gate computes realized RPT, BBO spread, mean/p95 all-in cost, timeout/cancel/partial rates, liquidation/wipeout counts, and remains paper-only/fail-closed.
Existing decision artifact requires microstructure telemetry and at least two weeks paper/testnet observation before real-money review.
Tests enforce paper/testnet-only, no market fallback, BBO requirement, and blocked clean-OOS RPT failure handling.
Tests encode train/validation RPT and 15/20bps stress proxy fields; 10bps RPT gate is not relaxed by dominance logic.

gaps_to_close_before_clean_live_eligibil: Generalize primary-cost constants into explicit 10/15/20bps verifier rows, including assertions that all rows exist.
Add or surface tail-loss quantiles/CVaR alongside MDD; current cost-aware metrics expose MDD but not tail quantiles.
Wire capacity/liquidity proxy outputs into Alpha Zoo verifier artifacts, not only generic cost-aware framework output.
Summarize paper/testnet all-in cost and slippage telemetry by symbol/timeframe with missing-field counts before any real-money review.
Keep locked-OOS metrics report-only and out of objectives, pruning, fitting, selection, and parameter grids.

gate_matrix.implementation_note: Prefer replayed trade streams; if algebraic stress is used, label it proxy and keep it out of locked-OOS selection.
gate_matrix.pass_condition: 10bps is the primary hard gate; 15bps and 20bps must be explicitly replayed or computed from frozen trade streams and reported. Missing any cost row blocks eligibility.

gate_matrix.formula: split_total_return * 10000 / max(split_turnover, epsilon) for backtest proxy; realized_pnl_quote * 10000 / sum(abs(notional_quote)) for paper fills
gate_matrix.pass_condition: RPT must exceed the scenario all-in round-trip cost for train and validation. A 10bps RPT failure is an immediate reject; 15/20bps failures downgrade to shadow/diagnostic until the leader approves a different predeclared policy.
required_controls: no locked-OOS RPT in selector objective

gate_matrix.pass_condition: turnover and trade_count must be explicit per split/timeframe; zero or missing turnover cannot support an RPT or capacity claim. Low-sample rows remain warning/reject according to the predeclared family profile.
p90 participation must stay within the predeclared max_participation cap and p99 breaches must be explained. Report estimated post-cost Sharpe/return at 0.5x, 1.0x, 1.5x, and 2.0x AUM.
Backtest assumptions must be listed separately from paper/testnet realized costs. Missing BBO, high-spread, or high-slippage paths fail closed with no market fallback.
MDD must be within the predeclared budget, liquidation/account-wipeout counts must be zero, and missing tail quantile/CVaR fields block any clean live eligibility claim.
Paper/testnet evidence is mandatory before real-money review. This artifact does not allow paper or real execution; it defines telemetry required for a future review.
